title: Pure Nekroz
summary: Nekroz cards only, with generic staples; the page's Herald partner is left out. The 2025 wave leads. Emilia, Dance Priestess of the Nekroz summons itself while a Warrior Nekroz is in your field or GY and searches a Ritual Monster or Spell. Avance, Swordsman of the Nekroz summons another Nekroz from the Deck when Normal Summoned. Both pay for a whole Nekroz Ritual Summon on their own. Nekroz Divinemirror is a Quick-Play Ritual Spell that Ritual Summons from the hand or banishment on either player's Main Phase. Nekroz of Metaltron, a Pendulum Ritual Monster, banishes itself until the End Phase to deal with a monster. The older Ritual Monsters still discard themselves from the hand to search, recover or negate.
